mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE user_id <> '__deleted_user__') AS userCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review) AS reviewCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment) AS commentCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM watchlist) AS watchCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingReportCnt
SELECT user_no, user_id, user_name, user_email, user_img, user_role, join_date FROM users WHERE user_id <> '__deleted_user__' ORDER BY join_date DESC

SELECT r.review_no AS reviewNo, r.movie_no AS movieNo, COALESCE(m.tmdb_id, r.movie_no) AS tmdbId, m.title AS movieTitle, r.user_no AS userNo, COALESCE(u.user_name, '탈퇴한 사용자') AS userName, r.rating, r.content, r.reg_date AS regDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_like rl WHERE rl.review_no = r.review_no) AS likeCnt FROM review r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_no = r.user_no LEFT JOIN movie m ON m.movie_no = r.movie_no ORDER BY r.reg_date DESC

SELECT rp.report_id AS reportId, rp.reporter_mid AS reporterMid, rp.target_type AS targetType, rp.target_id AS targetId, rp.reason AS reason, rp.status AS status, rp.reg_date AS regDate, COALESCE(m.tmdb_id, 0) AS tmdbId, m.title AS movieTitle, rv.content AS targetContent FROM report rp LEFT JOIN review rv ON rp.target_type = 'REVIEW' AND rv.review_no = rp.target_id LEFT JOIN movie m ON rv.movie_no = m.movie_no ORDER BY rp.reg_date DESC

SELECT rp.report_id AS reportId, rp.reporter_mid AS reporterMid, rp.target_type AS targetType, rp.target_id AS targetId, rp.reason AS reason, rp.status AS status, rp.reg_date AS regDate, COALESCE(m.tmdb_id, 0) AS tmdbId, m.title AS movieTitle, COALESCE(rv.content, c.content) AS targetContent FROM report rp LEFT JOIN review rv ON rp.target_type = 'REVIEW' AND rv.review_no = rp.target_id LEFT JOIN comment c ON rp.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.comment_no = rp.target_id LEFT JOIN review crv ON c.review_no = crv.review_no LEFT JOIN movie m ON COALESCE(rv.movie_no, crv.movie_no) = m.movie_no WHERE rp.report_id = #{reportId}
